title: Streamlit Application and Configuration

learning_objectives: Explain app.py, static landing page, and model dependencies in plain language and connect it to app.py; .streamlit/config.toml.
Trace one input through the streamlit application and configuration stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: app.py, static landing page, and model dependencies
practical_outcomes: Trace the streamlit application and configuration stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for app.py, static landing page, and model dependencies.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
